lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm very tired and want to sleep.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: What time do you go to bed at night?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 太晚了！你要早点儿休息。
lines.pinyin: Tài wǎn le! Nǐ yào zǎodiǎnr xiūxi.
lines.en: That's too late! You need to rest earlier.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do I need to take medicine?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 先不吃药。多喝水，早点儿睡觉。
lines.pinyin: Xiān bù chī yào. Duō hē shuǐ, zǎodiǎnr shuìjiào.
lines.en: Not for now. Drink more water and go to bed earlier.
